title: Wrong Item Claims: Share of the Shipment Made Good
content:
Under Delivery Claims, the part of an order's delivery charge a Wrong Item Claim covers follows how much of the shipment the claim made good.

**Rule.** The covered share depends on how much of the shipment the claim made good: where the units of the claim's merchandise refund entries reach every unit booked on the order, the claim covers 100% of the delivery charge; where they reach at least half of the units booked on the order but not all, it covers 50%; in every other case it covers none.

## Terms

- Units of the claim's merchandise refund entries: the sum of the units on the Wrong Item Claim's merchandise refund compensation entries.
- Units booked on the order: the sum of the units on the order's booking lines.

| Units refunded on the claim, against units booked on the order | Covered share of the delivery charge |
|---|---|
| all of them | 100% |
| at least half, but not all | 50% |
| fewer than half | none |

## Edge cases (hypothetical orders)

| Units booked on the order | Units on the claim's merchandise refund entries | Covered share |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 4 | 100% |
| 4 | 3 | 50% |
| 4 | 2 | 50% — exactly half |
| 4 | 1 | none |
| 3 | 2 | 50% |
| 3 | 1 | none — below half |
| 1 | 1 | 100% |

Units reshipped are not merchandise refund units and do not count toward the share.
